item.name: statements/{id}/erasure
Erase one owned health statement and every record derived from it, with a verified receipt.

request.name: Erase one owned health statement and every record derived from it, with a verified receipt.

description.content: AS-002 per-statement erasure. Goes after the statement and every controlled copy: the facts, observations and hypotheses derived from it (their text is cleared once they are withdrawn), assessment reports naming them and consultation runtime state, each target verified on its own. Still-asserted derived records, adopted Diagnosis conditions citing the statement and active plans resting on them block with a review signal; nothing here changes a Diagnosis or a plan. Frozen replay inputs (Diagnosis runs, revisions and proposals, plan proposals and accepted revisions) are never rewritten: decision_records ends retained_by_policy and the request ends erased_with_retention, never erased. One erasure exists per statement; repeating the command (with any key) retries it, including after the review. An idempotency key already used for another statement is a 409. Foreign or missing statements return owner-masked 404.
